messages:
olivia.sales: Heads-up 10x Solutions signed today. Signed SOW includes private deploy (VPC) + SSO + enhanced logging. Revenue: $180k ARR. Onboarding runway: 30 days. Renewal risk note: they told us theyre evaluating alternate vendors in 10 months; if first 30 days are rocky, renewal probability drops.

marco.cs: I'll take primary CS. Marco assigned. Quick health snapshot: low risk now but onboarding velocity critical. Need eng + support sync to lock infra & enablement plan.

devon.support: I'll spin up a support intake ticket and collect access. Do we have a security contact? Any compliance flags?

olivia.sales: Security contact: jude@10xsolutions.com. Compliance: none (no PHI) but they require detailed audit trails for prompts. Also want a 1-hour enablement session for platform admins on day +7.

lee.eng: From eng: need expected peak RPS, average tokens, and if they will route model requests through our hosted endpoints or private model. Also confirm whether they require custom metrics exposed to their Datadog.

marco.cs: Customer prefers private deploy with a hosted-model fallback. Peak: 12 RPS, avg tokens 60, p95 latency target <500ms. Datadog integration: yes (API key will be provided).

devon.support: Ticket created: 10X-ONB-9022  https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/10X-ONB-9022. Added labels: onboarding, vpc, datadog, audit-logs. Assigning to eng-runtime + eng-platform + cs.

sec-bot: New ticket created 10X-ONB-9022 by devon.support. SLA: 48h to initial plan.

lee.eng: Proposed rollout: week1 staging private deploy (smoke tests + audit log validation), week2 controlled traffic, week3 go-live. Infra ask: service account with kube-admins, CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16, NS record ownership. I'll post infra checklist in ticket.

marco.cs: Enablement plan: 60-min admin training (day+7), 30-min dev workshop (day+12), and a single point of contact for escalation. Action items:
- marco.cs: onboarding doc + runbook + admin training slides (due 2026-04-10)
- lee.eng: infra checklist + deploy runbook (due 2026-04-08)
- devon.support: create support access + escalation playbook (due 2026-04-07)
- olivia.sales: send customer admin list + Datadog API key (due 2026-04-05)

olivia.sales: I'll share the admin list today. Also flag: customer asked for a simple feedback loop so they can report early quality regressions directly to CS.

marco.cs: We'll capture feedback via a shared doc + periodic 2-week check-ins for the first 3 months. Ask them to provide 4 representative prompts and 20 sample responses we can use for baseline eval.

lee.eng: For monitoring, we'll expose per-route latency and token counts to Datadog, and wire an alert when model-quality score (from eval harness) drops 10% vs baseline. Need sample prompts to seed eval.

devon.support: Added watchers: natasha.sre and rachel.security to ticket. Also documented escalation path: devon.support -> lee.eng -> natasha.sre.

marco.cs: Quick runbook snippet I'm adding to the ticket:
```
Runbook (initial onboarding):
1) Provision VPC & service account (eng)
2) Deploy staging stack w/ audit-logging enabled (eng)
3) Smoke tests: 100 requests @ 5rps, verify audit entries (cs/support)
4) Enable Datadog metrics; run 24h stability test (sre)
5) Schedule admin training (cs)
6) Gradual traffic ramp + post-launch check (cs/eng/support)
```

olivia.sales: Thanks team. I'm marking renewal-watch in CRM and adding a note: "must hit enablement + audit validation within first 10 days."

devon.support: Will update 10X-ONB-9022 with owners & attach admin training slot options. Next sync: Thu 2026-04-01 11:00 PT.

marco.cs: Great. I'll follow up after Thu sync with the onboarding doc link and action trackers. :white_check_mark:
